title: Good Tidings for Those Who Did Their Best
body:
Madad, madad, madad, madad, madad, madad, madad, madad, ya Sahibu’ l-Waqt, madad! Allahu akbar, wa
lillahi ‘l-hamd! Subhanallahi-l `Aliyu-l `Adheem.
As-salaamu `alaykum, ya haadireen (attendees). O our attendees! The Last Day is approaching and people
are running away. But we are believers for the Last Day, (so) be ready for the Day of Judgment. As-salaamu
`alaykum. Welcome to you, who is asking from their Lord’s rahmah, their Lord’s blessings, welcome. Keep
the right way and you should reach Blessing Oceans, no doubt! Day by day we are getting weaker. O People!
Listen and obey and try to be obedient servants.
O our Lord, forgive us! O our Lord, You are sending Your beloved, most beloved, glorified and honored
servant to Your creation. He is not only for Mankind, he is also for every creation. Without his way nothing is
coming to existence. Every creature is coming through the way of the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad
(s). (Mawlana stands) As it is mentioned through holy books, the Lord of Creation, Lord of every creature,
was saying, “O My most beloved and honored and glorified one! If I am not bringing you in existence, I am
not bringing anything in existence!”
We are Muslims, Ahl as-Sunnah wa 'l-Jama`ah, for whom the Seal of Prophets (s) said, “When the Last Days

are approaching, my nation is going to be divided into 72 branches; 72 different (kinds of) ideas they should
carry and they are going to say: ‘Our ideas or our knowledge only is true and others they are on wrong ways.’”
That is something they are claiming, and the judgment on their claim should be on the Day of Resurrection,
on Judgment Day, yes!
People, now only a quarter of a century remaining for coming of the Last Days, to come the Day of Judgment,
Yawm al-Qiyamah. Then the books for this planet are going to be closed down, finished. Just the last one’s
(Prophet’s) name written; just he came in existence, no more new names; that is the Last One. The Seal of
Prophets (s) was saying that his nation is going to be on 72 different ideas, different thinkings, different
practicings, against what the Seal of Prophets just brought and taught to his Ummah. Now on Earth there is
only one Ummah; no more for Sayyidina Ibrahim (a) or Sayyidina Nuh (a), Sayyidina `Isa (a) and Sayyidina
Musa (a) and others. No one now on this planet, only Ummati Muhammad (s). (Mawlana stands for honor of
Prophet [s] and sits.)
That is going to finish when the trumpet is blown. As when you were at school, there was a doorkeeper
(Mawlana blows his whistle), and that means (school is) finished. That trumpet when blown (everything will
be finished)! Now, some small `alamaat (signs) coming, like this, (Mawlana blows whistle weakly). (But when
the) big trumpet (is blown, it means): Ya Allah! Tawbah, astaghfirullah! All of us are on way now. A special
angel on behalf of Sayyidina `Azra’eel coming for everyone. He has countless helpers. He is coming for some
special, true people. For people like ourselves he is sending some helpers, making like this, falling down.
Now this world is going to its end; life is going to end. Tooba, good tidings and happiness for those who did
their best through this life. And their soul will just be taken or carried from their bodies so gently (and that
angel will invite), “Come, please come to your Lord’s Heavenly Presence.” Who should be there in Heavenly
Presence? Sayyida ‘l-awwaleen wa’l-aakhireen, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana stands for honor of
Prophet [s] and sits.) For some-ones, angels are giving good tidings, “The Seal of Prophets (is) waiting for
you!” They should be in his heavenly presence. Some-ones who were on the right path, following the Seal of
Prophets, will be told that, “You are a blessed one, go now to reach the most blessed one on your heavenly
level, to be there.” Tooba lahum, biggest good tidings!
O People! Day-by-day we are getting to be melting. I was once in a tourist ship. My masters were making me

to be there. I was with Shaykh Hisham, taking me there on a big ship, (and the) youngest one of those people
was like me, 30 years or 40 years, double 50! (laughter)
(Mawlana mimics a conversation)
“O my darling, you are looking where?”
“O my darling, I am looking there is a pool, a strange beauty and dancing, and I was asking if I can be for that
young one? I am now 90 years; so quickly passed my life years. What I am looking and seeing so beautiful,
but I can’t reach... “
“Where it is, O my darling?”
“There! I am in need a telescope to see where is that one....”
“Just in front of you! I may change my eyeglasses, but I never see....”
“Doesn’t matter....”
Then it was early morning and that ship making a tour and coming in evening. That old one coming to see
and look once again, and looking:
“Where they are taking? Might be such a raees (leader, chief) may carry, but not anyone else can carry that
one! I may ask to him: ‘O my friend, I was looking early morning such a beautiful figure through there.’”
“Hearing?”
“A little bit I am hearing.”
“What happened? Anyone taking it away?”
And raees ul-ashair was saying, “How old are you? I am reaching to 99 and how old are you?”
“I am yet 97.”
“Doesn’t matter!”
“What happened, who taking that?”
“O my clever friend! It was ice, but making a beautiful shape to enjoy, me and you.”
“What happened?”
“Just melted!”
He was crying, that one, “Ahhh, so beautiful and just melting!”

O people, what I mean to say, day-by-day also we are melting. We are melting! We are not same as yesterday
and tomorrow it is not going like today. We are melting and one day Allah, Allah, Allah! People they never
thinking on such a things. Whole peoples ideas to reach to that, to reach to that, to kill that, to destroy that, to
burn this! That is not human’s characteristic, that is beast’s characteristic! But what we are saying? All
nations, including Muslim world, they are not listening daily to naseehat (advice) of the Seal of Prophets (s).
Never listening! And now a heavy cloud coming on Earth. SubhaanAllah, Holy Qur’an mentioning
everything!
When Allah Almighty was asking to punish the Children of Israel because they bowed to (the golden) cow, He
ordered to kill them - (the) innocent to kill those accused ones. When they were looking and their relatives
going to be killed, they were very sorry, and some of them, their hands can’t be able to. Then Allah Almighty
sending a black cloud and day going to be night. And they were killing those whom they worshipped (the
golden) cow, until Maghrib time. Sayyidina Musa (a) and Sayyidina Haroon (a) were bowing to Allah, saying,
“O our Lord, give Your Mercy for remaining ones, or the Children of Israel will just be finishing!" and that
this cloud was getting away.
Now whole world is in such a way. We are not looking and seeing that black cloud, but we are just on it.
Therefore, people making themselves like human bombs and getting through people and killing so many
people. They are in such a (wrong) way and divinely revenge waiting for them!
O People! O Israel people! O Palestinian people! O Urdun (Jordanian) people! O Syrian people! O Iraqi
people! and others and others! Open your eyes and look what is informed to nations through holy books - to
be in safety here and Hereafter - or that cloud coming down and there will be punished not millions, but
billions!
May Allah forgive us, for the honor of the most honored one in His Divine Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad
(s). (Mawlana stands for honor of Prophet [s] and sits.)
Fatihah!
